messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran into an ambiguity in the docs: some pages use `model_tag`, others `model_version`. This is showing up in the SDK migration guide examples and confusing customers. Can we do a quick triage?
jordan: Where exactly?
maria: SDK config page (snippets) and the migration guide examples. One snippet uses `model_version`, another uses `model_tag` (and the separators differ: `:` vs `@`).
lina: I can sweep and open a PR. Do we have a canonical term preference? I lean toward `model_version` because it matches our /serve API param.
patrick: :thumbsup: I also prefer `model_version`. That said, infra dashboards use `model_release` in metrics in a couple places.
maria: Ok — sounds like we need a mapping plan: `model_tag` (deprecated) -> `model_version`, and `model_release` -> `model_version` (follow-up infra rename). Also we should document the separator normalization to avoid copy/paste errors.
jordan: Proposal: adopt `model_version` everywhere in public docs. SDK should accept `model_tag` as a temporary alias with a deprecation warning. Docs PR should: 1) update inline text/snippets, 2) add a migration snippet showing old->new, 3) add a glossary entry + redirects for old terms.
maria: I'll draft the docs-site PR (content + glossary stub). Lina — can you handle updating the SDK snippets and adding the migration code example?
lina: Taking SDK snippet. Draft migration example to include in the guide: 
```python
# old
client.generate(model_tag='redwood-13b:2025-11-01', prompt='Hello')
# new
client.generate(model_version='redwood-13b@2025-11-01', prompt='Hello')
# SDK will emit a deprecation warning if `model_tag` is passed for now
```
Also will add a short note about the separator change (`:` -> `@`) and why we picked `@` for the canonical form.
patrick: FYI ops: I'll file an infra ticket to update metrics labels/dashboards that still use `model_release` so visible dashboards line up with the docs change.
devex-bot: Reminder: docs PR checklist requires link-check, snippet-run tests, and CODEOWNERS review. Assigning to @maria and @lina.
maria: Thanks. Targeting PR by EOD Wednesday. I'll also stub a glossary entry `model_version` with recommended wording and example.
jordan: Quick QA note — please run the new snippet against both hosted and dedicated endpoints to confirm alias handling and the warning text.
lina: Will test on dedicated and post results here.
maria: Great. Adding this to #doc-queue and will paste the PR link once opened. If anyone sees other occurrences (internal guides, support KB), drop them here and I'll add to the PR diff.
